status: Partial My Shadow item/companion implementation; full acceptance remains open.
attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors; wiki-derived behavior summary CC BY-SA 4.0. Local tuning and implementation evidence are identified separately.

sources.supports: Repentance contact familiar, friendly Chargers, source 20 HP/8.7 damage/16 cap, room lifetime, vulnerability and named interactions.
Exact tuple 23.0.1, baseHP 20/stageHP 0 and generic collisionDamage 1. Allied damage is the documented item override, not this generic field.
Collectible 433 appears in devil and greedDevil pools with weight 1, decrease 1 and removal threshold 0.1.

source_contract.producer: One movement-following shadow with a short delay; enemy contact produces friendly black Chargers. Source familiar radius is slightly larger than the baseline player body.
source_contract.allies: Wander until cardinal enemy alignment, then straight dash; 20 source HP and 8.7 contact damage. At most 16 alive, lasting only for the room.
source_contract.damage: Contact and damaging hazards can exhaust their HP. Ordinary player explosions are exempt; named ghost explosions are exceptions.
source_contract.interactions: Athame death rings and Jumper Cables death counter, Duct Tape attachment, Eraser normal-Charger precursor, Ace conversion, Broken Modem/Stop Watch slowing and Blood Puppy team exception are separate requirements. BFFS and Box of Friends have no effect.

excluded_editions: Pre-Repentance hurt-triggered fear/spawn, 5 damage and 5-Charger cap.
Afterbirth-only Drowned substitution and Punching Bag targeting.
implemented: External companion/contact_familiar rows and exact stable item key isaac:collectible:433. Local bargain pool is the Devil analogue; no hostile floor pool or Mine roster additions.

One producer regardless of copies, bounded delayed path history, per-enemy contact interval, live plus pending 16-child cap and item/producer provenance. Removing the item removes its producer without deleting living room allies.
Shared Charger controller now selects aligned enemies for friends, including a farther aligned hostile when a nearer enemy is unaligned; it never acquires the player.

Separate allied outgoing/incoming contact damage and independent cooldowns; real hostile projectile interception before player, harmless passage of player bullets, friendly bomb immunity, hostile/neutral explosion and damaging flame/beam/ring/creep exposure. Explicitly harmless hazards remain harmless.

Companion damage/death events are distinct from ordinary enemy events; no friendly death loot, hostile kill counter, chain reward or native Powder/Ghost kill effects. Ordinary hostile kills caused by allies still receive existing player-side kill hooks.
Room transition expires allies and path history without death effects; they are never stored for re-entry. Living allies are not room threats.
Dark Original-style bodies with teal ally rings and a separate ground shadow familiar; allied actors no longer draw hostile attack warnings.
Actual item key survives floor advancement and the existing summary-journal round trip; room-limited allies expire and the new floor builds a fresh producer/path. Live combat is not resumable.

deathward_adaptations.units: Allied HP 64 = source 20 times 3.2; contact damage 27.84 = source 8.7 times 3.2. Existing hostile damage is converted by .32 for these allies (ordinary 10-point contact becomes 3.2); this is explicit local unit conversion, not an extracted native coefficient.
deathward_adaptations.timers: Shadow lag .15 seconds, radius .6 versus player .48, per-enemy spawn interval .25; outgoing contact interval .7 and incoming shared hurt interval .45. Exact native values are not established.
deathward_adaptations.movement: Base wander 1.5 and dash 11 with existing normal charge duration/alignment/recovery. Allies do not receive hostile movement aggression scaling. Real 3D height/LOS/navigation apply.
deathward_adaptations.damage_policy: Hostile projectiles may intercept companions; beams, rings and damaging floor hazards share their hurt window. Neutral barrel/powder blasts explicitly hurt allies; ordinary player dynamite does not. These 3D/faction policies need source-measurement acceptance.
deathward_adaptations.economy: Smuggler bargain weight 2, existing maximum-health trade and seeded offers are the local Devil-pool analogue. Exact source pool depletion/Greed mode are not implemented here. Tutorial and Mine offers retain existing paths.
deathward_adaptations.visuals: Procedural black body, teal allegiance marker and charcoal ground familiar fit Original rendering. Existing world-space protagonist shadows remain; this is not a copied Isaac sprite or exact sprite-shadow removal.

unresolved: Athame, Jumper Cables, Duct Tape, Eraser, Ace cards, Broken Modem/Stop Watch and Blood Puppy exceptions still need concrete content support; distinct event/provenance plumbing alone is not those implementations.
Exact native contact/spawn/hurt timings, familiar hitbox and source damage-resistance behavior remain unmeasured; current values are declared local tuning.
3D contact against elevated/airborne targets and broader status/charm/faction behavior need source and gameplay validation.
Source item pool depletion, unlock conditions and Greed-specific routing remain separate unfinished systems.
All-camera mixed-threat readability, varied-build/human balance and controlled native/WASM performance acceptance remain open.
